name: Bundle-aware BxGy settings
description: Configure bundle exclusion and Buy X Get Y% off
title: Bundle-aware BxGy
helpText: Exclude collection-pair bundle units first, then: buy X items from the qualifying collection (blank = all) to take Y% off the cheapest item(s) from the eligible collection (blank = all). Example: X=2, Y=100 → Buy 2 Get 1 Free.
bundleHelpText: Products in this collection that form a live collection-pair / hoodie bundle are excluded before BxGy runs. Must match the live bundle discount collection.
paidCountHelp: Number of qualifying items that must be paid full price in each group. Use 2 for Buy 2 Get 1 Free, or 1 for Buy 1 Get 1 50% Off.
qualifyCollectionHelp: Units that count as paid toward a group. Leave empty to allow all products.
eligibleCollectionHelp: Units that can receive the discount (cheapest first). Leave empty to allow all products. Paired bundle units never receive this promo.
percentHelp: Percent off each discounted eligible unit. Use 100 for free.
